name: novel-continuity
description: Extract, validate, query, and diagnose canonical story state with provenance.
procedure: Read the relevant manuscript and existing canon notes.
Check time, knowledge, location, possession, injury, relationships, and world rules.
Record evidence-backed findings and canon updates in project docs, citing chapters and scenes.
Reconcile conflicts with the author's intent; report uncertainties explicitly.
Choose the next step from the author's goal and current project state; keep progress in project docs and verify persisted tool results.
